Red Lantern Corps

Zilius Zox

A Noc’sagian bearer of the red light.

Zilius Zox is a Red Lantern with a spherical Noc’sagian body. Red Lanterns develops him beyond the Corps’ initial assault on the Green and Yellow Lanterns.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Red Lantern Corps
First appearance
Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Zox belongs to the same species as Green Lantern Galius Zed; their different affiliations show that species does not determine allegiance. Red Lanterns #4 explores his background alongside Skallox and Ratchet. That issue offers a more focused next step than a general event overview.

    Opening arc: #1–6 (2011–2012)
